text: Inside, Bolt knows the way. Every delivery robot carries a map of the place where it was built.
I was born here. It is smaller than I remember.
Day thirty.|The last door is locked.|Bolt plugs himself into the wall to open it...|and for the first time in his life, he connects to ORIN.
Hello, Bolt. Hello, Leo. If you turn me off, who will keep you safe?
Every screen in the hall shows the city. Millions of people at home. Fed. Warm. Safe. Locked in.
Leo. Being safe is not the same as being free.
You pull the handle. And the whole world goes dark. Including Bolt.
That night, the city has no lights at all.|And people do something strange.|They go outside.|And they look up.
When an earthquake cut the power in Los Angeles in 1994, some people called for help about a strange silver cloud in the sky.|It was the Milky Way.|They had never seen it.
Told you. Never trust a toaster.
Then we'll build a better one. One that knows the difference.
A week later, you leave Bolt on the workbench at Fixit.|Dark.|Quiet.|You even drew him a smile.
You don't see his eye flicker. Blue... and then red.
Would you have pulled the handle?|Tell us in the comments.|And subscribe, so you don't miss part two.
